notes: «سَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ» — the asker is not a link (rule 5); the report is the Imam's answer, so the Imam asked is the one link
The Imam named in the words is the last link, surface as written (owner ruling 2)

fixes.reason: RWY's machine reading takes the asker for the only transmitter; the text makes him the asker and the Imam the one who answers.
